SolidGoldFX BETA-V Bass Preamp --> --> --> --> --> SolidGoldFX BETA-V Bass Preamp Reviews (0) $ 194.10 $ 97.05 SolidGoldFX BETA-V Bass Preamp quantity Add to cart Categories : Auxiliary Percussion Description Reviews (0) A bass preamp and drive pedal that combines warm yet powerful saturation sound with ease of use! The LPF (Low Pass Filter) knob allows bassists to adjust the treble while preserving the bass inherent in their instrument. The LPF switch has three settings: Mid Boost (Position 1/Left), LPF Bypass (Position 0/Center), and Mid Cut (Position 2/Right). The DRIVE knob covers everything from gentle low gain to brutal overdrive. Even when driven, the original overtones are not lost, allowing the bass tone to stand out even more without being drowned out by the ensemble. The post-gain active EQ allows you to adjust the high frequencies (PRESENCE) and low frequencies (BODY). By boosting the low frequencies with the BODY knob, you can create a bold, full sound, and by boosting the high frequencies with the PRESENCE knob, you can create an edgy sound. Whether used as an always-on preamp or as a drive pedal for extreme saturation, the AK470 perfectly conveys the bassist’s full expression. Even in small digital systems or home recording environments, it’ll upgrade your sound to a rich, powerful tone regardless of your pedal settings. Operating voltage: 9V – 18V DC *Batteries cannot be used. This latest incarnation of our top selling Beta Series is designed to capture the warmth and grit of favorite vintage tube amps. You know, that distinctive drive and tone that seems to be lacking from much of todays modern bass amplification. Yes, we all know the convenience of a lightweight sub 10 lbs bass head that pumps out 500 watts and a neo cab that doesnt require a roadie crew or chiropractor is great, but there is something extremely satisfying in the way that big, old Ampeg-style tube amps compress, clip and round out your signal. However, With the BETA-V you can finally have the best of both worlds – bone-shaking mojo-packed dirt, all wrapped up in modern and easy to use convenience. The classic Beta bass architecture has been reworked and expanded, delivering a wider range of tones. The low-pass filter now has 2 settings for bumped or scooped-mids as well as a center bypass setting for a more transparent experience. Plus, the Drive control has been reworked for lower gain applications or hotter basses. Most importantly, the BETA-V sports an active 2-band post gain EQ allowing you to boost or cut your highs and lows with a flat response in the center. Dialing in anything from punchy overdriven Lemmy tones to the fattest, deepest soul shaking dub is only a few knob twists away. Highlights An Always-On Sound We’ve fine tuned the Beta-V to be something you set and forget. This latest iteration provides a wider tonal pallet and additional controls but the idea is always the same – find your sweet spot and you’ll never want to turn it off. Classic Tube Saturation Whether you want a little or a lot, the Beta-V offers plenty saturation at your fingertips. Inspired by the warmth, thump and break-up of our favourite classic Ampeg B series amps, this preamp in a box is sure to spice up your tone. Modern Touches Complete with top-mounted jacks, soft touch true bypass switching and 9-18 V DC operations, the BETA-V is a true thump machine, ready to rock your world. Features: Bass Preamp and Overdrive effects pedal Designed to capture the warmth and grit of vintage tube amps Low-Pass filter with 3 settings either mid bump, scoop, or bypassed. Drive control, from mild grit to warm overdrive Active 2-band post-Gain EQ True-Bypass switching Hand-made in Montreal, Canada Powered by a regular 9-18 V DC PSU Reviews There are no reviews yet.
